gaps.explanation: Governmental detail holds only the Schedule of County Treasurer Activity (p13, total 207,563), which equals the 'Property taxes' row of the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds - Cash Basis (p4: General 189,483 + Street 18,080 = 207,563). None of the other p4 fund-column rows are in detail. Adding every other non-zero revenue row per fund column (Property taxes excluded to avoid double counting with the treasurer schedule): General Fund 653,620 - 189,483 = 464,137; Street Fund 213,945 - 18,080 = 195,865; Keno Fund 212,978. Debt Service Fund column is all zero. Added 464,137 + 195,865 + 212,978 = 872,980 = gap; 207,563 + 872,980 = 1,080,543 = statement total. Categories follow the statement lines (General 'Sales and other taxes' = taxes; Street 'Sales and other taxes' and 'Fees, taxes, permits and licenses' = motor vehicle tax, per budget schedule p8).
